items.title: Bella Cornish Interview
items.q: My sister used to fix the dinner for him when they come over there

ctx.x: My sister got acquainted with him, you see, after he was married to me. My sister used to fix the dinner for him when they come over there, fix their dinners for all of them. Mm-hmm. Yeah.
Did you say Dr. Bichet had five pictures of yours or just that one?
